note: Raised when a board's title on the one face came to break only between words — its type drawn smaller until its widest word fits, measured in the type it is drawn in, and a word wider still cut on its line (`titleThatFits`) — and a building going while the history plays came to stay in its place among the others and be taken away when its sink has played out (`inTheirPlaces`). Measured at 3_378_307 / 1_227_762 against 3_376_275 / 1_227_110.
